name: Rachel Clark
source:
A physics teacher at Tina Koya High School. She has a reputation as one of the cooler teachers, but also one of the scarier ones when annoyed. She believes in discipline and can often be seen trying to whip Tori and Vanessa into shape. Rumor has it she used to be quite the delinquent herself as a teenager.
